jobs.occupation: Start your career as an Audit Graduate at Deloitte Copenhagen 2027
jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 2700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

Would you like to start your audit career at Deloitte's head office?

At our Copenhagen office you will get 600 Audit & Assurance colleagues across departments. We have a strong sense of community, with many joint events, from Friday bars to courses and development opportunities. This gives you plenty of opportunity to build a strong network and a foundation for where your career at Deloitte will take you.

Job Description

As an audit graduate, your day-to-day work will take place in either our Portfolio or Large & Complex departments. You will be assigned to one of our four client segments: Public, Private, Financial Services, or Top Tier and your daily work will be team-based. You will have a dedicated department manager and a coach to support your personal and professional development.

You will quickly become part of your new community and have ample opportunity to build new relationships.

As an audit graduate you:

• Always work in audit teams and be in close contact with both colleagues and clients - often working on site at the client's premises.

• Acquire extensive knowledge of your department's clients and, most importantly, the skills to advise and audit them.

• Assist in planning client's audits, coordinating efforts with, for example, Deloitte's Service and Delivery Centres, which handle many of our administrative tasks, ahead of the reporting season.

• Contribute to risk assessments of accounting areas, using your knowledge of the client's internal processes.

• Work with an experienced audit team to conduct audits to ensure that the financial statements give a true and fair view.

Your role will vary depending on which department you join but we promise that your days will not be the same. There will be room to learn, to ask for help, and to grow and take on the responsibility you want.

NEXT - our graduate development programme

When you join as an audit graduate, you enter a full-time role and will join our internal development programme, NEXT, along with around 100 other graduates across the country. You are regularly brought together for training and to prepare for new roles.

Depending on where you are in your training when you join us, you will also be studying part-time at the university. And for your first 100 days with us, you will be assigned a buddy who has been through the experience of being a new graduate and will help you settle into your new role.

Qualifications

There are several paths to become an audit graduate in our audit business. We are open to your educational background and to you completing a level of training while you are with us. The most important thing is that you have the interest and motivation to learn. And it is important that you:

• Want to develop personally.

• Are curious about auditing.

• Have social skills that will support your future relationships with clients and colleagues, and team-based working.

• Can show relevant professional experience or extra curricular activities , in which you have excelled.

• You speak and understand both English and Danish, or any of the other Nordic languages.

• You are eligible to work within the EU, either as a citizen or with the correct permits.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Click on "I am interested" above to apply for this position.

Please attach your CV and grades from your current and previous education. Please do not upload a traditional cover letter. Through the application process we will also ask you to answer a few questions about your motivation for the joining Deloitte.

We process applications and arrange interviews continually.

Expected start date to be 10.09.2027.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard on mobile: +45 53793260 or email: talent@deloitte.dk

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Are you reliable, hardworking, and ready to become part of a busy warehouse and logistics environment? Then you might be the person we are looking for!

We are currently looking for several warehouse workers for full-time positions with our customer in Taulov near Fredericia. We are looking for employees for different warehouse tasks on both day and evening shifts, and for the right candidates there may be opportunities for longer-term assignments.

You do not necessarily need several years of warehouse experience or a forklift licence. What matters most is that you have the right attitude, are reliable, and are comfortable with physical work in a fast-paced environment.

• Picking and packing goods

• Relabelling products

• Preparing goods for shipment

• Sorting and handling goods

• Unloading containers

• General warehouse and logistics tasks

• Helping to keep the warehouse clean, organised, and structured

• Is reliable, flexible, and responsible

• Is interested in working within warehouse and logistics

• Is comfortable with physical work and a good working pace

• Can work independently as well as part of a team

• Has a positive attitude and is ready to take initiative

A forklift licence is not required for the current positions, but if you have a forklift licence or previous warehouse experience, this is of course an advantage.

These are full-time positions on either day or evening shift:

• Day shift: typically 07:00–15:00

• Evening shift: typically 14:00–22:00

**About the team:

**

The Pandora SecOps team is part of the Global Security department, responsible for detection and response across Pandora's entire value chain. Over the past few years, we have built a robust technology platform that allows us to respond to alerts and incidents with greater speed and accuracy. This evolution has shifted the team towards an engineering-led approach, where the platform itself is treated as a product: designed, built, and continuously improved through code. The team owns the entire platform and all the technology components within, which enables full control and autonomy of the design decisions.

Pandora's broader shift towards PaaS and SaaS solutions is changing what our platform and team must deliver. Detection and response can no longer be anchored solely in traditional infrastructure telemetry; it must extend into application-level monitoring and the services our internal product teams build and operate. At the same time, operational technology (OT) across Pandora's manufacturing and production environments is becoming an increasing part of the detection and response scope, adding a new class of telemetry, constraints, and stakeholders to the platform. Practices like vulnerability management and exposure management are also capabilities that heavily rely on proper data platforms and pipelines.

This represents a paradigm shift in the SecOps operating model. From operating a security stack in relative isolation to engineering a data and detection platform in close collaboration with application and product teams across Digital & Technology (D&T).

About the role:

As a SecOps Platform Engineer, you will own the engineering, evolution, and reliability of the core detection and response platform, including our XDR, SIEM and NDR and the pipelines that feed it.

A central part of the role is driving and delivering the data foundation required for the shift towards application monitoring: onboarding new telemetry from PaaS and SaaS services, engineering scalable and cost-efficient ingestion, ensuring data quality, and building the platform capabilities that allow detection and response to cover applications and enterprise infrastructure. You will take ownership of selected components in our detection-as-code pipeline and the workflow integrations that connect the platform into the wider SecOps ecosystem. Also, practices like vulnerability management and exposure management, which rely heavily on proper data platforms and pipelines, are converging ever closer with detection and response, and platform engineering plays a key role in integrating these capabilities into one coherent operational system.

As part of the role, you will also be expected to take part in the internal SecOps on-call roster, ensuring coverage for critical alerts and incidents outside normal business hours. On-call participation is compensated in accordance with our on-call compensation scheme.

This is a senior role within the team. As with all senior members of Pandora SecOps, you will be expected to step in and drive incident response efforts when needed.

Key responsibilities:

• Own the continuous improvement of the SecOps technology platform, including XDR, SIEM and NDR, with a platform-as-code and infrastructure-as-code approach (versioned, peer-reviewed, CI/CD-deployed).

• Drive the data platform agenda: design and deliver scalable telemetry ingestion and log onboarding for PaaS and SaaS services, cloud platforms, and internally developed applications.

• Engineer and maintain workflow integrations across the SecOps ecosystem (SIEM, NDR, EDR, SOAR, IAM, ITSM), ensuring stable, secure, and observable connector and integration performance.

• Partner with application and product teams across D&T to embed security monitoring into new services, define logging and telemetry requirements, and shape the collaboration model between SecOps and product engineering.

• Collaborate closely with Detection Engineers, SOC Analysts, and Security Principal Architects to ensure platform capabilities are grounded in real operational needs and enable the full detection and response lifecycle.

• Ensure platform reliability, health, and performance through monitoring, capacity management, and root-cause analysis.

Qualifications:

• At least 5 years of full-time experience in security engineering, security operations engineering, or SecOps platform engineering, with demonstrable seniority appropriate to a manager-level individual contributor role.

• Solid hands-on experience from working within a SOC or incident response setup.

• Proven experience engineering and operating SIEM platforms, including data connectors, analytics rules, workspace architecture, ingestion optimization, and cost management. Experience with NDR platforms is a strong plus.

• Applied experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Bicep/ARM, or equivalent), including managing security platform content and configuration through version control rather than manual administration.

• Demonstrated working experience with Git, DevOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines applied to security tooling - for example detection-as-code, automated content deployment, or pipeline-driven platform changes.

• Proficiency in Python for building integrations, API clients, data onboarding tooling, and automation supporting platform operations.

• Solid understanding of cloud and identity ecosystems relevant to Pandora's environment: Azure, Entra ID, and Active Directory

• Knowledge about monitoring patterns for PaaS/SaaS services and modern application architectures is a plus.

• Experience integrating security platforms with enterprise tooling (e.g., SOAR, ITSM) and maintaining stable, secure, and well-documented integrations.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with application and product teams, translate security requirements into engineering deliverables, and influence without formal authority.

Further Information:

This role is a Career Band 4B (Individual Contributor) and reports directly to the Director, Information SecOps, Analytics & Incident Response and will join a team of 4 colleagues.

If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you! We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. Are you ready to drive finance-critical IT projects at the heart of ALK's journey to SAP S/4HANA — shaping how a global pharmaceutical company runs its finance reporting and analytics?

About ALK

ALK's aspiration is to become the world leader in allergy by helping as many people as possible with allergy to a better life by providing options of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of allergy. In Global IT, we contribute to this aspiration by supporting the organization with modern IT tools and digitalisation technologies, and by delivering world-class support to our many colleagues around the world.

The Role

As a Senior IT Project Manager at ALK, you will lead important finance-related IT initiatives from inception to execution, with a central role in our S/4HANA journey. You are first and foremost a strong project manager and facilitator who can guide the business through change. Your tasks will include:

• 
Ensuring timely, on-budget project delivery and successful milestone achievement.

• 
Aligning project outcomes with the strategic vision of the business.

• 
Coordinating internal and third-party resources effectively.

• 
Facilitating workshops and supporting the business through the change process.

• 
Driving finance projects with an emphasis on reporting, analytics and data modelling — including the redesign of our BW setup — alongside the connected changes across the core finance ERP.

• 
Steering the relationship with the Steering Committee and Project Group towards collaborative success.

Being structured, organized and proactive, you will anticipate issues before they arise and know when to involve the right people at the right time.

This role is based at our headquarters in Hørsholm, Denmark, where you will work closely with the hiring manager and senior finance leadership. As our SAP team is located in Madrid and much of the finance team sits in Kraków, you can expect regular travel to both locations.

What We're Seeking

We are on the lookout for a candidate with:

• 
A master’s degree in engineering, business or relevant fields.

• 
Proven experience in IT project management, ideally with finance, reporting or analytics projects.

• 
Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills, and the ability to support a business through change.

• 
A structured, organized and proactive working style.

• 
Familiarity with SAP, S/4HANA and BW/data modelling — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable operating in this landscape and speaking with the specialists. Having already been part of an S/4HANA journey is a strong advantage.

• 
Willingness to travel internationally, primarily to Madrid and Kraków.

• 
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

• 
Familiarity with GxP pharma environments is desirable, but not mandatory.

Why ALK Global IT?

ALK's IT division is a robust team of approximately 150 professionals with IT hubs in Hørsholm, Madrid, Kraków, and with employees throughout our production and sales networks in Germany, France, North America and China. We prioritize professional growth and learning, valuing competency and knowledge exchange over formalities and encouraging a collaborative spirit every day.

Become a part of ALK

ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process.

We operate production sites in Denmark, France, Spain, and the United States, with a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. Our headquarters is located in the scenic DTU Science Park in Hørsholm, Denmark, which will be your primary workplace for this role.

Join us at ALK and be a part of an organization that values integrity, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of those we serve.

Ready to Apply?

Don’t miss the chance to impact the allergy world and advance your career with ALK. Apply today

As our Senior Reward Analyst you will join a close-knit Reward team, working cross-functionally with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and fellow "Trusties" to drive data-informed people decisions. Our mission is to deliver equitable, transparent, and market-competitive compensation and benefit programs that attract and retain top global talent. In this role, you will tackle exciting challenges—from designing total reward dashboarding and leveraging compliant AI solutions to leading key annual review cycles, equity grants, and global market benchmarking. You will also play a pivotal role in advancing our pay equity analysis, statutory gender pay gap reporting, and job architecture, directly reinforcing our commitment to an inclusive, transparent, and open-to-all workplace culture. If you are a collaborative data enthusiast eager to deliver impactful insights and elevate our global reward strategy, we would love to welcome you aboard.

What you’ll be doing:

• 
Analyze market data to inform compensation and benefit decisions that will enhance our ability to attract top talent across the countries the business operates

• 
Stay up to date with market trends and legislation to advise identify risks and opportunities

• 
Support/lead on activities required to deliver a well communicated and accurate annual salary review, bonus calculation, equity grants, benefits window and promotion cycles.

• 
Partner with Finance on budget modelling, cost analysis and scenario planning.

• 
Support the design of new/updated benefits, short term incentives and long term incentives

• 
Run regular pay equity analysis and support statutory gender pay gap reporting (EU, UK and any other applicable countries).

• 
Ensure reward practices comply with relevant employment and pay transparency regulations

• 
Maintain job architecture, levelling and job evaluation consistency across the organisation

• 
Build and maintain dashboarding to give leadership visibility on reward health

• 
Prove robust analysis on key reward topics (share dilution, range penetration, pay mix)

• 
Utilise AI in a compliant way to deliver efficient solutions

• 
Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition on reward topics to gain a deep understanding of the business needs and ensure they have the data and expert advice needed to make people decisions

• 
Create and communicate clear and user friendly total reward communications and educational material (including ad hoc comms, cyclical communications, benefits communications and total reward statements)

Who you are:

• Proven experience in a reward role or associated discipline

• In-depth knowledge of key reward and HRIS processes and concepts

• Expertise working with people data and people systems / HRIS (currently Sage HR)

• Advanced spreadsheet skills with the ability to manipulate and analyse large volumes of data

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex data and insights in a clear, concise manner

• Collaborative mindset and ability to communicate cross-functionallyAbility to work autonomously and learn new skills and concepts rapidly

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Do you want to play a key role in some of Denmark’s largest and most complex energy infrastructure projects? Are you an experienced planner who creates structure, transparency, and progress in complex projects? Then join us at COWI and help shape the future of sustainable energy infrastructure.

Become a vital part of our Energy team

As a Senior Planner, you will play a key role in planning and delivering large and complex energy and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will work at Energinet as part of a COWI team supporting some of Energinet’s important projects. You will take ownership of project schedules and work closely with project managers, technical specialists, contractors and suppliers to create transparency, manage dependencies and risks, and keep projects moving forward.

Furthermore, you will support projects throughout their lifecircle – from early development and design through tendering and execution. Beyond maintaining schedules, you will function as a trusted sparring partner to project management, using planning and schedule analysis to support informed decision-making, identify challenges and drive corrective actions. Through your work at Energinet, you will gain the opportunity to contribute directly to projects that are central to Denmark’s energy infrastructure and green transition.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

Your key responsibilities

As a Senior Planner, you will:

jobs.description:
PhD scholarship in the intellectual history of corporate politics at CBS

Copenhagen Business School invites applications for a vacant PhD scholarship within the field of the intellectual history of coporate politics at the Department of Business Humanities and Law. Expected starting date is 1 May 2027.

The PhD position is a non-tenured full-time position of 3 years, with teaching and course work obligations.

The research will be conducted as part of the Independent Research Fund Denmark Sapere Aude Grant project Visions of corporate politics: Intellectual histories of the state-firm analogy. The project team will consist of the PI, one postdoc and one PhD.

Read more about the project here: https://dff.dk/en/our-funded-projects/meet-the-researchers/research-leaders/eksterne-personer-en/research-leaders-2025/mathias-hein-jessen/

The central objective of the research project is to analyze contemporary contestations over the state-firm boundary as well as mobilizations of analogies between state and firm in projecting political and economic visions. The project analyzes the constitution of the state-firm distinction as well as what it terms contemporary ‘visions of corporate politics’ represented by ideologically distinct answers to the crisis of liberal democracy which both contest the state-firm boundary and mobilize the state-firm analogy to legitimize their vision: On the one hand attempts to democratize or politicize the firm and on the other hand attempts to build political communities on principles of corporate governance. The PhD project will focus on one of the two contemporary visions of corporate politics.

Examples of potential research topics: the democratization of the firm; democratic or economic planning; employee ownership; platform cooperativism or socialism; network states; gov-corps; start-up governments; freedom cities.

The research conducted will be team-based and oriented towards delivering on the project objectives. Taking the project framework into consideration, applicants are required to outline their reflections on how to approach the study.

The position is mainly in-place. The candidate should be able to be regularly present and attend meetings in Copenhagen.

For more information about the position, please contact PI of the project Associate Professor Mathias Hein Jessen (mhj.bhl@cbs.dk).

About Department of Business Humanities and Law (BHL) at CBS

Department of Business Humanities and Law explores how people, organisations, institutions, and societies shape business. Its core research themes include entrepreneurship, business ethics, leadership, governance, culture, learning, business history, and business law from commercial and societal perspectives. The department comprises three academic units and nine reseach groups.

Teaching responsibilities of the Department include undergraduate and graduate teaching as well as teaching in post-experience and doctoral education. Some programmes are taught in Danish, some in English.

Within BHL the position will be located in the Governance, Culture and Learning Unit, an interdisciplinary research environment connecting governance studies at all levels of global society.

PhD programme

The three-year PhD programme at CBS gives you the opportunity to conduct research under the supervision of CBS’s associate professors and professors, supported by research related PhD courses. The programme is highly international, and you are expected to participate in international research conferences and to spend time at another research institution as a visiting PhD student. See the CBS homepage for more information about the PhD programme, https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programme.

CBS PhD graduates are held in high esteem not only in academia and research institutions but also in government and business where their research qualifications are in high demand.

CBS is committed to ensuring excellence, transformative and relevant teaching and research. Candidates who wish to join us must be interested in working in an organisation of this type and it is expected that the applicant shows an interest in joining the department's research environment. You can read more about the department's research here: www.cbs.dk/bhl.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have completed a master’s degree in intellectual history, history, political sociology, political theory or political philosophy.

The assessment of the candidate will be based primarily on the following qualifications:

• Research within the history of political, economic or legal thought, political theory, or political philosophy.

• The ability and desire to work autonomously and as part of a team

• Excellent organizational and communication skills (both oral and written); proficiency in English is required

• Ability to engage with others in a way that reflects a collective commitment to diversity, equality, and inclusion.

Application and admission requirements

The department will give priority to applicants with high grades from their universities. To be considered the applicant must

• have a basic education at master's level (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process)

• have received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master's thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale(https://ufsn.dk/english/education/the-danish-education-system/grading-system/)

• have a weighted grade point average of at least 8.2 on the Danish 7-point grading scale for the bachelor's and master's degree combined or alternatively a weighted grade point average must be at least 9.5 for the master's degree alone. If the grade point average is not met, documentation for being in the top 40% of the class is also accepted.

• have completed the master's programme before starting the PhD programme at CBS

• master academic English at a high level in writing and speaking

The application (see link below) must include a five-page PhD project description. The project description must include:

• a presentation of an original research question

• a description of the initial theoretical framework and method

• a presentation of the proposed empirical material

• a work plan for the three years

More information can be found here: https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programmes/admission

In addition to the project description, copies of the following must be included:

• motivation cover letter

• diploma for bachelor's and master's degree or other certificates at an equivalent level as well as the grade transcripts

• documentation for being in the top 40% of the class (if grade requirements are not met). In rare cases, the grade requirement can be waived.

• a concise curriculum vitae (CV)

• a list of articles and publications (if applicable)

• one example of a selected written work (e.g. master's thesis)

• documentation of English language skills is not required for the application but may be requested if the applicant is shortlisted for interviews.

The PhD student is enrolled in the CBS PhD School. Further information about PhD scholarships and the PhD programme can be found at https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/phd-programme.

For further information please contact Associate Professor Mathias Hein-Jessen, email mhj.bhl@cbs.dk or Head of Department Pia Bramming, email pib.bhl@cbs.dk. Information about the department can be found at www.cbs.dk/bhl

Employment and salary

A PhD scholarship runs for a period of three years and includes teaching obligations corresponding to 416 work hours. The scholarships are fully salaried positions, according to the national Danish collective agreement. The monthly salary is currently approximately DKK 30,264 up to DKK 36,877 depending on seniority and a pension contribution totalling 18,07 %. The scholarship includes tuition fees, office space, course and travel costs (according to the current CBS agreement).

Salary level and employment take place in accordance with the Ministry of Finance's agreement with the Academics' Central Organization.

Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee comprised of tenured faculty shortlists at least two-five applicants to be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline.

Applicants shortlisted for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and will receive the result of their personal assessment later. When the assessment committee has finished their work selected applicants will be invited for an interview. Please note that a positive assessment does not automatically result in an interview. Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

The application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see above), by the application deadline.

Details about Copenhagen Business School are available at www.cbs.dk/en.

This Integrations Engineer role

Light is only as powerful as the systems it connects to. Money doesn't move because we say so—it moves because we speak the language of the bank, the e-invoicing network, and the planning tool on the other side, correctly, every time, for every customer entity. This role owns that layer: the interaction surface between Light and the rest of the financial world.

You'll build and operate the integrations that let Light plug into multi-tenant banking APIs (J.P. Morgan, HSBC, and peers), global e-invoicing networks, and tax platforms and more. This is backend-heavy, data-integrity-critical work where a dropped message or a silent reconciliation mismatch is not an acceptable outcome. You'll design the abstractions that turn a dozen incompatible partner APIs into one coherent internal model, and you'll keep those abstractions honest as partners change their specs underneath you.

What you'll work on:

• 
Bank connectivity. Build against corporate banking and payments APIs—account information, payment initiation, status reporting, FX—across providers like J.P. Morgan Payments and HSBC. Handle the realities of bank integrations: certificate-based and mTLS auth, OAuth flows, ISO 20022 (pain/pacs/camt) and legacy MT formats, sandbox-to-production parity, and rate limits that assume you're a bank, not a startup.

• 
Multi-tenancy done right. Our customers are many legal entities operating in many countries. You'll design integrations where credentials, configuration, and data are isolated per tenant, where onboarding a new entity is a workflow rather than a code change, and where one customer's failure never leaks into another's.

• 
Global e-invoicing. Connect Light to e-invoicing networks and country-specific mandates (Peppol and the growing set of national clearance and reporting regimes). Map between formats, manage compliance-driven edge cases, and keep delivery auditable.

• 
Tax platforms for statutory filing, US sales tax and much more.

• 
Reliability and reconciliation. Idempotency, retries, webhook and polling strategies, dead-letter handling, and end-to-end reconciliation so that what we think happened and what actually happened always agree.

Your qualifications

4-6 years of experience ideally, plus…

You build things. Not prototypes, not demos. Working software in production, doing something real for real users. This is the non-negotiable.

You've built integrations against unforgiving external systems. APIs you don't control, that fail in ways the docs don't mention, where correctness is contractual. You know how to defend a system against a partner that returns a 200 with an error in the body.

You know banking and payments APIs. Direct, hands-on experience with corporate banking, treasury, or payments APIs is what sets the strongest candidates apart. Experience integrating J.P. Morgan or HSBC specifically—their developer platforms, auth models, and payment and reporting APIs—is highly valuable and a genuine differentiator for this role. Familiarity with ISO 20022, SWIFT, virtual accounts, or open banking is a strong signal.

You are excited about AI. You use AI tooling efficiently to improve your work. At Light, a lot of code is written with AI, which means the hard part is increasingly the thinking: deciding what to build, reviewing what comes back, and catching where the model is confidently wrong. You know when AI speeds you up, when it's likely to mislead you, and how to lean on it while staying fully responsible for what ships.

You're comfortable across the stack. You don't need to be a specialist in everything, but you can't have a lane you refuse to leave. Our stack is Kotlin and React, and this role leans backend. If you're strong on the backend and curious about the rest, that works.

You care about data integrity. You think about the person on the other end and the money moving between them. You notice when a flow is correct but fragile, and you act on it.

You ship early and often. Small batches. Learn. Go again. You'd rather put something real in front of a customer than spend another week perfecting it in isolation.

Bonus points

• 
Experience in fintech or systems where data integrity is non-negotiable

• 
Familiarity with accounting concepts: debits, credits, reconciliation

• 
Experience with e-invoicing standards or country-specific compliance regimes

• 
Background in high-growth startups where everything was still being figured out
